description:
An ideal gear to carry on a walk is the Sharp MD-DR 470H minidisk player and the Soundman OKM II binaural microphones, because both don´t take much space and make good recordings. 

This recording was done on the 03.06.2006 in the Harz
Mountains, the first major hills in the north of Germany. The stream is
called the Innerste and it was pretty full of water. A nice clear sound.
name: Mountainstream.WAV
